request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Composition findings, four submissions**", "2": "Contrasting two smoothed flow rates across groups (V02 versus V03) failed: information coefficient near zero, t-statistic about minus 0.2.", "3": "Scaling smoothed V04 flow by V06 stock, standardized against own history, was weak overall but strongly negative in high common-index periods.", "4": "A cross-sectional stock-minus-flow contrast limited to high-index periods barely helped.", "5": "Inverting the ratio, V06 stock over unsmoothed V04 flow, standardized against own history and limited to high-index periods, worked best: information coefficient 0.09, t-statistic 1.56, low overlap with base signals.", "6": "Caveats: low rank persistence means high turnover, coverage is 73 percent, and significance is marginal."}, "hypothesis": "In high common-index regimes, groups whose V04 flow is elevated versus own history while V06 stock is depressed versus own history earn higher next-month relative returns, exploiting the negative high-index V06 effect observed earlier.", "expression": "regime(spread(tsz(V04,\"exp\"),tsz(V06,\"exp\")),\"high\")"}
